# Write Primitives merge_scd_type2_new_keys_only

```{tags} reference, query-template, write_primitives
```

> [Write Primitives](../../write-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Write Primitives queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
INSERT INTO scd2_ops_dim_customer
SELECT
  (
    SELECT
      MAX(sk)
    FROM scd2_ops_dim_customer
  ) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.c_custkey),
  s.c_custkey,
  s.c_name,
  s.c_address,
  s.c_acctbal,
  s.c_mktsegment,
  s.row_hash,
  TRUE,
  s.effective_ts,
  CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE)
FROM scd2_ops_stage_customer AS s
WHERE
  s.change_type = 'new'
  AND NOT EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM scd2_ops_dim_customer AS d
    WHERE
      d.c_custkey = s.c_custkey
  )
```
